name: Gemini MCP
tagline: Use Google Gemini models, embeddings, and vision from chat.
shortDescription: The Gemini MCP server. Run any Gemini model (Pro, Flash, Flash-Lite), use the 1M+ token context window, generate embeddings, and analyze images and video. The fast and cheap option.
longDescription:
## What it is

The official Google Gemini MCP server. Exposes the Gemini API as MCP tools: chat completions with any Gemini model (2.5 Pro, 2.5 Flash, Flash-Lite), embeddings, vision, video understanding, and function calling.

## Why we recommend it

Gemini's context window (1M+ tokens) and price/performance ratio make it the best choice for long-context tasks. The MCP server gives your agent access to all of it.

## When to use it

- Long context: agent loads an entire codebase or book into context
- Vision/video: agent analyzes images and video with Gemini
- Embeddings: agent uses Gemini embeddings for RAG
- Cost: Gemini Flash is one of the cheapest capable models
installInstructions:
1. Get an API key at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey
2. Set `GOOGLE_API_KEY=...`
3. `npx -y @google-gemini/mcp`

**Free tier:** 15 requests/minute, 1M tokens/day, 1,500 requests/day.
pricingDetails: Free. The MCP server is open source. Gemini: generous free tier. Paid: $0.075-$3.50 per 1M tokens.
